question:
A dice has its faces marked by symbols α, β, θ, γ, π and δ . Two positions of the same dice are given below. Which face is opposite to face β?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59b846f66da2d8c5e6ecaad48d679e1d459abf86a750bf2becf6eeaefdf77149.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

To find the opposite surface of β we need to compare the common surface in the given dice,

now θ is common in dice 1 and dice 2

So, from Dice 1 and Dice 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/162d70ec7e39be8d634dcb82778e7c1564936ba5cf972eba8bbe24858bbdb790.png] 

 

θ is common in both the dice, it is clear that α, β, γ, π and δ are adjacent surface

So,** remaining θ will be opposite side to β**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
